assays.assay_description: Observation of head twitches in non-implanted, freely moving mice after i.p. injection of 5-MeO-DMT.

application_type.evidence: Following the intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection of 5 mg/kg 5-MeO-DMT

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum throughout the experiment

sample_size.evidence: A subset of animals was not implanted and were used to monitor head twitches ( n = 4)

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-DMT induced head twitches characteristic of psychedelics. The effect was further enhanced when co-administered with the 5-HT1A antagonist WAY-100635.
outcomes.evidence: the injection of 5-MeO-DMT did induce head twitches, as characteristic of psychedelics

assays.assay_description: Latency to interact with a cup of sugar pellets and to consume them, recorded by video for 1 h after i.p. injection in the home cage.

application_type.evidence: received either a vehicle (saline) or a 5 mg/kg 5-MeO-DMT injection at dark onset

setup_habituation.evidence: the bowl was introduced without prior habituation

setup_restrain.evidence: tested in home cage, freely moving

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum throughout the experiment; sugar pellets available during test

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum throughout the experiment

time_to_assay.evidence: The bowl of sugar pellets was placed on the cage floor 10 min after the injections

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-DMT increased the latency to cup interaction and pellet eating, shifting predominant behaviour to grooming or exploration. Authors interpret this as reduced appetitively motivated behaviour.
outcomes.evidence: 5-MeO-DMT increased the latency to cup interaction and pellet eating ... and shifted predominant behaviour to grooming or exploration

B1_num_measures.evidence: latency to cup interaction and latency to pellet eating; also grooming/exploration shifts

B4_ethological.evidence: approach, eating, grooming and exploration are natural behaviours scored as distinct acts

D3_recording_days.evidence: On day 0 (familiarization), day 1 and day 4 (crossover injections)

D4_baseline.evidence: On day 0, the bowl was introduced without prior habituation 10 min after dark onset

assays.assay_description: Pupil diameter tracked with a head-mounted miniature camera (oculometer) and quantified using DeepLabCut in freely moving mice for ~60 min after i.p. injection.

application_type.evidence: injection of either vehicle or 5-MeO-DMT at light onset

setup_habituation.evidence: videos of freely moving mice were recorded following one 1-hour session of habituation to the device

setup_restrain.evidence: unrestrained mice wearing the oculometer exhibited normal spontaneous behaviours

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum throughout the experiment; recording in home cage

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum throughout the experiment

time_to_assay.evidence: recordings started at light onset and were followed by the injections of either vehicle or 5-MeO-DMT

sample_size.evidence: n = 6; ME analysis, effect of time point * condition: F40,121 = 3.43, p < 0.0001

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-DMT induced a marked (~75%) increase in pupil diameter lasting 10–15 min after injection, correlated with frontal SWA increase and occipital theta decrease. Pupil dilation was abolished by pretreatment with the 5-HT1A antagonist WAY-100635.
outcomes.statistics: ME analysis, time × condition F40,121 = 3.43, p < 0.0001; correlation pupil vs frontal delta r² = 0.59, p < 0.0001; pupil vs theta r² = 0.07, p = 0.16
outcomes.evidence: The injection of 5-MeO-DMT led to a marked increase ( + 75%) in pupil size lasting for 10 -15 minutes

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Dynamics of pupil diameter across time bins within session

B4_ethological.evidence: pupil size is autonomic, not ethological

E1_environment_type.evidence: recordings in the home Plexiglas cage

E4_nesting.evidence: mice exhibited normal nesting; nesting material present in home cage

E5_enrichment.evidence: no enrichment objects mentioned during recording

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water provided ad libitum in home cage

D1_continuity.evidence: crossover design: vehicle and 5-MeO-DMT recorded on separate days

D2_session_duration.evidence: only 60 min of video per subject per session

D3_recording_days.evidence: day 1 and day 4 (crossover injections); plus additional WAY conditions

D4_baseline.evidence: no pre-drug pupil baseline reported in same session

judge_notes: Merged 'Feeding Latency Test' (qwen, glm) and 'Sugar Pellet Approach Latency' (gptoss) into one assay — same paradigm.
Included Pupillometry as a distinct behavioural assay (autonomic but the primary measured outcome via DeepLabCut tracking of a freely-behaving animal); only gptoss included it.

Excluded EEG/LFP/MUA recordings, sleep deprivation manipulations, and intracortical infusion experiments as these are neural-recording or manipulation protocols rather than distinct behavioural assays.
Added WAY-100635 as a separate dosing entry since it was administered systemically as a 5-HT1A antagonist in conjunction with 5-MeO-DMT.

Set group_housing = 'no' (singly housed) per Methods. Set enrichment_housing = 'yes' with medium confidence because nesting material removal during SD implies nesting material is present in standard housing.
Food/water restriction set to 'no' across assays based on explicit 'ad libitum' statement, except wheel test where the wheel apparatus did not contain food/water (scored 'during').
